message: v1.8.32: Fix release ZIP manifest-missing download and harden Windows auto-updater
changelog: Enrolled Course Auto-Registration Beyond UOS 7-Digit Codes (src/core/blackboardColors.ts, src/scan/blackboardApi.ts, src/content/courseColorPainter.ts, src/utils/storage/coursesStorage.ts, src/content/activityFilter.ts): parseMemberships() now extracts alphanumeric subject codes (such as RES691 from RES691_SEP26 and DTC001) alongside 7-digit UOS catalogue numbers, discoveredCoursesWithColors() and autoRegisterDiscoveredCourses() keep all real enrolled Blackboard memberships (even without an undergraduate catalogue number) so every enrolled course registers instead of stopping at 1 Course, isOrientationOrSandboxCourse() filters Library Essentials guides, and activityCourseLabel() strips external-ID prefixes (RES691_SEP26 - ...) so courses do not create duplicate stream filter chips.

Flexible Postgraduate & Non-Credit Hour Weighting (src/utils/gpa.ts, src/core/userCourses.ts, src/core/semesters.ts, src/core/targetGpa.ts, src/core/courseDocument.ts, src/core/courseImportView.ts, src/popup/index.html, mobile-web/companion/index.html, src/popup/modules/coursesView.ts, src/mobile/app/11-courses-editor.js): Supported 0 to 60 credit hours (0.5 steps) across Course Editor, syllabus import, GPA/CGPA, and Target Grade calculations, preserving explicit 0-credit non-GPA courses (e.g. Doctoral Training Centre or workshops) instead of silently defaulting them to 3 credit hours.
